regions.text: Variable Frequency Digital Controller for Vibratory Feeder / SDVC31 Series
Acceleration Parameter (y): This parameter means the maximum Output Voltage as percentage of the Input Voltage. The Acceleration function is affected by this parameter.

Rounded instruction panel containing three bullet steps: press FUNC and ▲ simultaneously for 2 seconds to enter Advanced Parameters Adjusting status; press FUNC repeatedly until shifting to Acceleration Parameter Adjusting status (y); press ▲ or ▼ to adjust the parameter value.

regions.image_alt: Two small controller-operation diagrams. The upper diagram shows pressing FUNC and the up button. The lower diagram shows a controller display reading related to parameter y/acceleration function and
Smiling face icon marking a note or tip section.

regions.text: Note box with two bullet notes: adjustable Acceleration value (y) ranges from 100 to 150, and the default value is 120; the Saturation Indicator lights up when Output Voltage of the controller exceeds the limit.

layout_json.notes: 本页为数字版说明书页面渲染，不像纯扫描件；页面包含较多操作示意图和注释框，但主体仍有可读文本。背景有淡色 CUH 水印。
